name: Binglao Poker
description: Binglao is a high-action Pot Limit Omaha (PLO) variant where the deal parameters are randomized before each hand. By rolling a six-sided die, the dealer determines the number of hole cards each player receives (4, 5, or 6) and whether the game will be played as High-only or High-Low 8-or-Better. Popularized in the Nordic poker community and featured in the Norwegian Poker Championship, it requires players to master multiple Omaha formats and adapt their ranges instantly.

content.text: Binglao is a high-action Pot Limit Omaha (PLO) variant where the deal parameters are randomized before each hand. By rolling a six-sided die, the dealer determines the number of hole cards each player receives (4, 5, or 6) and whether the game will be played as High-only or High-Low 8-or-Better. Popularized in the Nordic poker community and featured in the Norwegian Poker Championship, it requires players to master multiple Omaha formats and adapt their ranges instantly.

Developed within the Nordic tournament poker circuit as a way to increase variety and skill testing in mixed-game festivals. It gained official recognition when it was added to the side-event schedule of the Norwegian Poker Championship week in Dublin.
Typically 2 to 6 players; the 6-max format is standard to accommodate the potential for 6 hole cards per player.
Standard pack, poker chips, one six-sided die (D6).
The dealer rolls the D6 to establish the hand rules. Players are dealt 4, 5, or 6 hole cards face down. Five community cards are dealt in the flop (3), turn (1), and river (1) pattern.

items.text: High-Only Binglao: The High-Low option is removed from the die roll outcomes.
